mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 73 degrees by the Verona Public Library with mainly clear skies, though the air quality index is currently elevated at 53. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 62 degrees, and there is no rain expected overnight.

In city news, road construction on highway M is shifting into phase two next week, which will impact traffic patterns for the next few weeks. Also, the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is moving forward with the bridge near Lincoln Street scheduled for closure from mid-September through November.
There is plenty to do with the Dane County Farmers Market happening today, plus live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company taking place today.
The Verona Police Department confirmed the arrest of a 34-year-old Madison resident regarding an incident that took place on Sunday, August 30.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach, and since the restaurant is open, you have plenty of time to stop by before they close at 10:00 PM.
